title: PyRUA-DataFarm: LLM Agent as a Cost-Efficient Teleoperator for Real-Ready Robot Data
summary: A coding agent built simulation tasks and expert policies, while a video model rendered simulated rollouts into labeled camera data. On five real-robot tasks, policies trained only on generated data achieved 93 successes in 100 trials versus 84 for policies trained on the same number of teleoperated episodes, and retained more successes under tested appearance shifts.
